pull_request.title: Infrastructure: publish project dashboard on GitHub Pages
pull_request.head: chore/dashboard-pages
pull_request.body:
Publish the Git-backed nODD dashboard at https://asalzburger.github.io/nodd/ after this PR is merged. This includes the previously local dashboard implementation and its record of PR #4’s bounded human envelope-baseline approval; the merged design documents remain DRAFT and the discrepancy stays visible.

The workflow validates every PR and creates a preview artifact. Successful main-branch pushes and manual runs on main deploy the allowlisted site through the github-pages environment; PRs never deploy. Build permissions remain read-only, with Pages/OIDC permissions confined to deployment.

AGENTS.md now requires a tracking/review update in every non-chore project PR. CI checks that rule and rejects scientific/evidence changes disguised as chores. `chore: ...` / `chore(scope): ...` PRs, their tasks and reviews are excluded from progress records and totals; the old dashboard infrastructure task is removed from those totals. Chores remain in Git/session history and still rebuild the site after merge.

Validation: 25 dashboard/update-policy tests and 15 logging/documentation tests passed; 14 JavaScript interaction assertions passed; workflow YAML and deployment conditions checked; 160 local links/fragments checked over 22 output pages; session records validated. Browser/mobile layout remains unverified. Hosted [CI passed](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/actions/runs/35227955340), including the policy check, Python/Node tests, build and preview artifact. Pages packaging/deployment were skipped for the PR as intended; first publication waits for merge.

Governing proposal: PLAN-NODD-DASHBOARD-001. Existing scientific context: DES-003 / ADR-006 and PR #4. No detector parameters, geometry or approval states changed. This is a chore PR and is intentionally absent from project progress tracking.

Repository setup verified: Pages uses GitHub Actions (`build_type: workflow`) and the `github-pages` environment allows only the `main` branch. Merge this PR to trigger publication; no branch or site deployment was performed during PR preparation.

events.text:
Workflow builds/tests every PR; main pushes and manual main runs package the
allowlisted site and deploy through github-pages. PRs never deploy. Build permissions
are read-only; Pages/OIDC permissions are confined to deployment. Main workflows
are serialized and every successful main push rebuilds the site, including chores.

AGENTS.md now requires same-PR tracking/review updates for non-chore project work.
CI checks actual changed paths and the chore title convention. Chores are excluded
from progress tasks/PR/review records and cannot mask scientific changes. Removed
the prior dashboard infrastructure task from progress; its historical records remain.
Added PR template, regression tests and maintenance/recovery documentation.

Reviewed official GitHub Pages/action/API documentation (2026-09-17). Initial
sandbox API reads failed; escalated reads confirmed no Pages site/environment.
Configured Pages with build_type workflow and a custom main-only environment
branch policy. This prepares publication after merge; no branch or site was deployed.
No detector parameter, formal approval state or scientific-source provenance changed.
